name: primary and secondary suspensions
usage_note: 本文二维模型中轮对仅有垂向自由度，车体和构架考虑点头及垂向运动；车辆自由度数不能直接当通用车辆定义。

complete_examples.text: In Fig. 2, the primary and secondary suspensions are used to connect the bogie and wheel, and the car body and bogie, respectively.

Additionally, Fig. 6 shows that most of the frequency content is below 15 Hz, demonstrating the primary and secondary suspensions’ ability to filter out high-frequency components from rolling contact.

ANSYS® [37] has also been used to model the train, using spring-dashpot elements to simulate the flexibility of primary and secondary suspensions, rigid beams to simulate rigid body motions, and mass point elements located at the center of gravity of each body, namely the car body, the bogies, and the wheelsets, to simulate mass and inertial forces.
